title: Other clubs: Club Forest, Beverly Garden, the Annex
summary: He played Club Forest and Beverly Garden; the dance floor, hostesses and the Annex.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Yeah, he left. He made some with- He was good. With Steve Lewis. Yeah, I know, I played with Steve too, but he regular band was Piron. Yeah, he played with Steve. Yeah, at Tranchinas. Yeah. And I played a long time at Club Forest up there with Duck Ones, many good fellas. See, where was the Club Forest?
Is that on Bourbon? No, I saw Metry.
I never knew it before my time.

That was a big place, right across from my, that big gambling place. Lillen Strong played that once he came in. He did too? Yeah. That, you know, called the Beverly Garden too. Oh yeah. The Beverly Garden. Beverly Garden.
Beverly Garden. Beverly Garden. Yeah, sure, I know where it is.
We played there a long time.
To get back to Tom Anderson, did they have a dance floor for the customers to dance too? Oh yeah, yeah, yeah.
Dance floor, yeah. They had a dance floor. Nice dance floor.
Customers mostly come in just for-

Well that time they had stars then, you know, stars. Oh yeah. The man come in and see the place packed, you see. Well if the man bomb or drink, they got percentage on it, you see. They draw the man's in there. They'd be packed with girls.
They had a lot of girls around there.
Oh yeah, plenty of girls. That's all they had. Then they had a place two blocks back that's called the Annex. Yeah, yeah. Billis Studios to run that.
Yeah, Billis Studios to run that. Yeah, they had some nice clubs around there.
